name: Artifact Storage
description: Store immutable, integrity-checked artifacts on shared cluster storage with quotas and retention.
capabilities: upload files in bounded chunks for later cluster processing
inspect, list, download and delete shared compute artifacts
extend artifact retention within configured limits

totalQuotaMb.description: Maximum bytes reserved by committed and active uploads, in MiB.

producerQuotaMb.description: Maximum bytes reserved by one artifact producer, in MiB.

maxArtifactMb.description: Maximum declared size of one uploaded artifact, in MiB.

retentionDays.description: Default lifetime of a committed artifact.

maxRetentionDays.description: Longest lifetime a caller may request.

gcIntervalMinutes.description: Interval between expired artifact and abandoned upload cleanup passes.

freeReserveMb.description: Filesystem free space kept unavailable to artifact reservations, in MiB.
